long_volume_asset_rule: A 100-page book requires exactly 50 approved, distinct original assets in assets/images/<theme>/. The generator never repeats 12 motifs to pad a longer book.
note: 100 pages / 50 designs is a commercial design target informed by observed independent coloring-book listings, not a KDP requirement or a sales guarantee. The sample remains 24 pages / 12 designs.
